sources.title: Candidates ghosted at 3-year high
sources.blurb: 53% of job seekers reported being ghosted by employers in 2025 — a three-year high.

sources.title: The Exact Follow-Up Formula
sources.blurb: Most candidates never follow up. A small follow-up cadence dramatically increases recruiter response rates.

sources.title: How Long to Hear Back After Applying
sources.blurb: The median time to first response after a job application is 6–7 days.

sources.title: State of Recruiting 2025
sources.blurb: The median employer time-to-fill runs approximately 44 days.

sources.title: The Job Application Process
sources.blurb: Completing a single job application takes approximately 23 minutes.

sources.title: State of Job Search 2025
sources.blurb: It takes roughly 32 applications per successful hire on average.

sources.title: Candidate ghosting statistics
sources.blurb: 48% of applicants received zero response in 2025.

sources.title: ATS Statistics: the 75% stat is fake
sources.blurb: The '75% auto-rejected' stat has no credible source — the black hole is human inattention, not ATS robots.
